mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% MoM and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases for 3 consecutive months and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales of Goods (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, the hypothesis is rejected.
